items.headline: Before you paste: a traffic-light guide
items.hook: Before you paste anything into an AI tool, ask which colour it is.
points: Your organisation's policy always comes first.
items.ask: Does your workplace have a rule like this?
items.summary: Three colours, one habit. Your organisation's policy always comes first.
checks: written and reviewed in this project
own writing: no claims about any product
includes the reminder not to paste customer or company data where data is involved

slides.title: Public information
slides.body: Something you could say in a public room: a published article, a press release, your own general question.

slides.title: Internal work information
slides.body: Check your organisation's policy before you paste it, and remove names and figures you do not need.

slides.title: Never paste
slides.body: Customer or personal data, passwords, anything confidential. Do not paste customer or company data into an AI tool.

items.source_note: Written for AI Daily Brief. No claims about any product.
